report_identity.report_title: BII Railway Transportation Technology Holdings Company Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides intelligent rail transit system products and services, mainly in Mainland China, across passenger information, data/integration and intelligent infrastructure businesses.
business_overview.revenue_model: Project and service contracts for rail transit systems, with milestone billings and one-to-three-year retention periods.
business_notes: 2024 revenue mainly came from Mainland China: HK$1,596.2m, with HK$25.4m from Hong Kong and HK$35.2m from overseas markets.
Orders on hand were about HK$3.23b at end-2024.
Contract assets include retentions; trade receivables and contract assets are a key audit matter.

years.working_capital_notes: Inventory, receivables and contract assets increased, but trade payables and restricted deposit release supported cash flow.
Receivables and contract assets consumed HK$324.930m of cash.
Receivables, contract assets and restricted deposits consumed substantial cash.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profits were stable, but three-year median operating cash flow was only HK$8.685m and median post-capex free cash flow was negative; profit conversion is weak for a project/retention-heavy business.

evidence.detail: Revenue HK$1,656.773m; operating profit HK$201.875m; parent net profit HK$167.604m.
Cash and cash equivalents HK$761.204m; bank borrowings HK$101.507m; other borrowings HK$283.262m; lease liabilities HK$38.530m.
Cash on hand and at bank HK$725.439m; restricted bank deposits HK$35.765m; RMB remittance from Mainland China subject to foreign exchange controls.
Trade and bills receivables net HK$1,213.638m; HK$28.262m pledged as security for other borrowings.
2024 operating cash flow HK$227.864m; capex HK$47.235m.
2023 operating cash flow HK$8.685m; capex HK$44.695m; restricted deposits HK$128.799m.
2022 operating cash flow negative HK$155.183m; capex HK$39.576m; restricted deposits HK$141.281m.

gaps: Annual report does not split unrestricted cash between listed parent, offshore subsidiaries and PRC operating subsidiaries; cash haircut is therefore conservative.
No precise maintenance capex disclosure; HK$45m is estimated from recent purchase of PPE/intangibles and nature of software/rail system business.
No exact required operating cash disclosure; estimate uses project business scale, cash operating cost and working-capital volatility.
